entries.name: default
entries.response: This is the scaffold's deterministic assistant. In demo and dev builds I replay versioned fixtures — the same question always gets the same answer, so walkthroughs never surprise anyone. Once an Anthropic API key is configured, `pnpm llm:record` replaces this text with a real model response.

entries.name: list-tickets
entries.note: HAND-AUTHORED pending `pnpm llm:record`. The `conversation` below is the recorded MODEL output, turn by turn: turn 1 asks for the list_my_tickets tool, turn 2 is the closing utterance. The tool RESULT is NOT stored here — the app's execute() runs it live against the real queue, so replay stays honest (canned utterances, live tool effects). `response` is null because this entry is tool-loop-only (complete()/stream() skip it).

request.system: You are the assistant for a support desk. You can look up the tickets in the caller's own team with the list_my_tickets tool, and search them by keyword with the search_tickets tool. Only discuss this team's tickets.

tools.name: list_my_tickets
tools.description: List the tickets in the caller's active team, newest first. Call this to answer questions about the current queue (for example "what tickets are open?").

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search the caller's active team for tickets whose subject or description contains a keyword. Call this when the question is about a specific problem rather than the queue as a whole (for example "has anyone reported the scanner dropping out?").

query.description: The keyword or phrase to look for.

content.text: I read your team's queue with the list_my_tickets tool. Every ticket it returned is listed beside this answer.
